name: Done-For-You Vivid Vision
for: Founders and CEOs who want their three-year Vivid Vision written and designed for them, with their leadership team involved.
covers: A guided process to clarify the vision, then professional writing and design of the final Vivid Vision document, plus a rollout plan for the team.

name: Vivid Vision Retreat
for: Founders, and founder couples, who want to build their Vivid Vision in person over a focused multi-day experience.
covers: An in-person retreat to clarify a three-year Vivid Vision for business and life, ending with a plan to bring it to life.

name: The Vision Driven Quest
for: Entrepreneurs who want to create their Vivid Vision themselves, at their own pace.
covers: An online course that walks through clarifying, writing, and rolling out a Vivid Vision.

name: Vivid Vision VIP
for: Founders who want one-on-one time with Jennifer to build their Vivid Vision and plan their next three years.
covers: A private VIP day, personal life first, then the business reverse-engineered from it, plus a team rollout plan.

name: Vision Amplifier
for: Anyone who wants a daily practice to stay connected to their vision.
covers: 15-minute daily guided breathwork sessions for connecting to your vision and staying in a creative, expansive state.
